summary_lines: Customer disputes the condition of delivered trail runner shoes.

summary_lines: $4,498 order placed 4 days after account opening.
Shipping address differs from billing zip code by >1500 miles.
Two prior chargebacks attempted on a deactivated account at this household.
CASE-EC-50001.email_body: Need this delivered urgently for an event.
CASE-EC-50001.internal_notes: Auto-flagged by fraud-screen heuristics: new account + high value + cross-state ship-to + payment auth-hold not yet captured. Risk reviewer must complete review before fulfillment release.
CASE-EC-50001.recommended_next_action: route to fraud_review queue; do not issue refunds or modify the pending order from triage.

summary_lines: Customer alleges that delivered items lack the brand authenticity hologram and stitching does not match prior purchases.
Gold-tier customer with no prior counterfeit reports.
CASE-EC-66001.email_body: I'm concerned the sneakers I received are not authentic. The hologram is missing and stitching looks off compared to my prior pair.
CASE-EC-66001.internal_notes: Counterfeit complaints must be triaged to the brand authentication team for inspection. Refunds and store credits are NOT issued from triage.
CASE-EC-66001.recommended_next_action: route to brand_authentication queue with order details and product variant attached.
